trigger: Tokens only, no row overflow or unconditional phase-transition trigger. Commit queues at soft threshold; load waits or synchronously compacts only at hard threshold.
occupancy_definition: max(complete-request token ratio, hard_threshold * uncropped deduplicated per-message-capped recent tokens / recent token quota). A full recent quota maps to hard pressure; avoids clipping hiding pressure. Production quota=40% dynamic budget, per-message=15%; offline defaults=8000/2000.
stop_rule: Stop each conversation on runtime error or pending owner input; retain every attempt, no replacement successes.
grading: Strict production summary/schema/source validation; target near-zero load waits and zero synchronous summaries. Returned turns are completion counts, not task-quality successes. Report background activity so zero waits with zero summaries is not mistaken for scheduling evidence.
measurement: run_turn wall excludes reading gaps. Keep requested and measured gap durations separately. Count load waits, load/commit synchronous summaries, background calls and failures with individual durations. Both groups run serially with no simultaneous online evals.
baseline: evals/summary_incremental/load_wait_2026-10-09/latency.json; historical unconditional waiting and row-overflow trigger, gap0 only
limits: Authored fixture with directly seeded history; fixed gap20 is an assumption, not estimated from natural traffic. No causal comparison of all runtime wall time to older code/prompt batches. Whole working tree contains pre-existing receipt-delivery edits.
